headline:
Broward insurance rates
just dropped more than
[[20 percent]]
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: Kin Insurance is cutting rates for its current Broward, Miami-Dade, and Palm Beach customers, not just new signups. That is a litigation reform story, not a marketing one.
takeaway: Check your renewal. The market that set your price is gone.
